**Triage Summary:**

All four findings are duplicate reports of the same critical vulnerability (CVE-2022-22965, Spring4Shell) affecting Spring Framework 5.3.17 across beans and web-mvc components. This is a known, actively exploited RCE with EPSS 0.997 and confirmed KEV status, but a fix is available. **Recommended Action:** Upgrade spring-beans and spring-webmvc to version 5.3.18 or later immediately—this is a straightforward dependency update with no hedging needed. Block the build until the upgrade is completed.
